Hi Samantha —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the single ask to keep momentum: lock the technical walkthrough + align the security and procurement owners so we don’t lose time on paperwork. Key notes: 
- Primary use case: near-real-time embeddings for query understanding (10k QPS target, 2s P99 requirement).
- Data sensitivity: PII-scrubbed logs for indexing; SOC2 and region controls required.
- Success metric for pilot: ≤75ms avg infer latency for representative subset, and cost estimates under the committed threshold.

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical walkthrough (45–60m) with platform + infra engineers (we’ll demo a sandbox run and KV cache behavior).
2) Security Q&A with Rajiv / security ops to validate evidence list.
3) Procurement touchpoint to confirm contract cadence and any required PO process.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Sep 14: 10:00–11:00, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Sep 15: 09:00–10:00, 16:00–17:00

Please confirm which window works and add who from your side we should loop in for security and procurement. I’ve attached a one-page discovery notes PDF and an initial list of evidence we typically provide.

Attachment: discovery-notes-20270907.pdf (summary; ~1 page)

Thanks,
